• U.S. ETP 30d net flow rose 93.4% vs prior 30D: Listed-product flows printing +$7.29B (93.4% vs prior 30D) indicate investors are still using ETPs as the primary regulated gateway into crypto beta—supporting demand even when spot prices are choppy. Treat these as directional planning ranges, not a base-case forecast.   • Product access expanded quickly, then concentrated: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETP approvals in 2024 (see ) widened listed access fast—yet the top three funds still carry about 65% of listed AUM here (IBIT ($59.75B), FBTC ($13.41B), GBTC ($9.75B)). For allocators and service providers, scale and distribution economics now matter at least as much as first-mover timing.
